text:
Ava: Quick sync — mapping cross-team deps for Q3 roadmap. Need to lock the critical path for the Dedicated capacity launch. Short list: eng-runtime KV-cache + quantization, eng-infra GPU quotas & peering, eng-sre load testing, product + sales alignment for private deploys. Who has lead times?

Noah: From Platform: I added a sheet: https://tiny.redwood/s/dep-matrix (internal). Key gates: GPU quota + network peering. Quota requests typically ~10 business days; we can provision a temporary pool for canary if infra can spin it up.

Priya: Runtime: KV-cache perf change needs a 3-week sprint (opt + benchmarks). Quantization tuning is an extra ~1 week. Also need evals on the top-10 prompt set to guard regressions. If KV starts Mon 04/06, canary earliest mid-April.

Diego: SRE: Loadtest is a 48h window. We'll need a dedicated test pool + synthetic workload. Can do the load once infra allocates the pool. Also require an automated rollback and throttles before rollout.

Marta: Eng-infra: GPU quota is the blocker. We've opened requests with the cloud account team; ETA 7-12 days but could be longer. Proposal: provision an 8-node ephemeral pool via partner credits to unblock canary. Product budget OK?

Samira: Sales: We have 2 enterprise POCs asking for private VPC by EOW. If we push the launch, we risk losing momentum. Can product prioritize a minimal private deployment path (no HSM, light compliance) for the POCs?

Ava: Proposed minimal launch criteria (agree or call out blockers):
- end-to-end p95 <= 120ms for standard LLM path
- pass KV-cache perf regression tests
- 48h canary with no major errors (>1% 5xx)
- infra pool provisioned + rollback policy in place
If any of the above fails, we hold the launch.

Noah: Agree. I'll add these gates as checkboxes in the rollout doc and sketch a timeline: 
```text
dep_matrix:
eng-runtime: KV-cache (3w) -> perf evals (1w)
eng-infra: GPU quota (1.5w) -> ephemeral pool (2d)
eng-sre: loadtest (2d) -> canary (2d)
product: docs + rollout playbook (3d)
sales: customer POC alignment (ongoing)
```
Can we assign owners? I'll tag leads in the doc.

Priya: Owner: Priya (eng-runtime). KV work starts Mon 04/06. I need the product eval prompt set and target SLAs for perf tests.

Ava: I'll drop the eval set in the doc by EOD. @Samira please confirm POC priority list so we know which customers to include in the canary.

Samira: Confirmed — Customer A (high), Customer B (medium). I'll add onboarding contacts + compliance notes to the doc.

PlannerBot: Reminder set -> milestone 'canary_readiness' due 1839510000.

Diego: Action: SRE will schedule loadtest for 04/20-04/22 once infra pool is live.

Marta: If cloud quota stalls, fallback to partner pool. I'll confirm fallback availability by 04/10.

Ava: Next steps: Noah update rollout doc with gates/owners; Priya start KV; Marta push quota + confirm fallback; Diego schedule loadtest; Samira finalize POC list. Follow-up sync Friday 10am PT. :white_check_mark:

(Short thread — will merge notes into the rollout doc and ping for blockers.)
